items.title: Ray Ricker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 27, 2022
items.q: There were some other people I mean Jeff Tyzik played a lot of these tours too, and helped on a lot of the recordings.

ctx.x: Yeah. So, yeah and I got to go back home and play in Red Rocks once. So Chuck, he liked me and he liked the things I could do. And because he liked friendly faces in the group you know, and if it was possible he would help people out. There were some other people I mean Jeff Tyzik played a lot of these tours too, and helped on a lot of the recordings.

When he did his first “Friends and Love” and I think it was followed by “Together,” what was — was there an attitude discernable from the Eastman Philharmonic about this young man who is coming in with these hand-written parts and bringing in an electric bass guitar and that kind of thing? How did that fly?
